1898	components:
1899	  schemas:
1900	    ProblemDetail:
1901	      title: Problem Detail
1902	      description: The schema for all error responses.
1903	      type: object
1904	      properties:
1905	        type:
1906	          title: Type
1907	          description: Full URL that originated the error response.
1908	          type: string
1909	          format: uri
1910	          example: 'http://localhost:9966/petclinic/api/owner'
1911	          readOnly: true
1912	        title:
1913	          title: Title
1914	          description: The short error title.
1915	          type: string
1916	          example: NoResourceFoundException
1917	          readOnly: true
1918	        status:
1919	          title: Status
1920	          description: HTTP status code
1921	          type: integer
1922	          format: int32
1923	          minimum: 400
1924	          maximum: 600
1925	          exclusiveMaximum: true
1926	          example: 500
1927	          readOnly: true
1928	        detail:
1929	          title: Detail
1930	          description: The long error message.
1931	          type: string
1932	          example: 'No static resource api/owner.'
1933	          readOnly: true
1934	        timestamp:
1935	          title: Timestamp
1936	          description: The time the error occurred.
1937	          type: string
1938	          format: date-time
1939	          example: '2024-11-23T13:59:21.3820407Z'
1940	          readOnly: true
1941	        schemaValidationErrors:
1942	          title: Schema validation errors
1943	          description: Validation errors against the OpenAPI schema.
1944	          type: array
1945	          items:
1946	            $ref: '#/components/schemas/ValidationMessage'
1947	      required:
1948	        - type
1949	        - title
1950	        - status
1951	        - detail
1952	        - timestamp
1953	        - schemaValidationErrors
1954	    ValidationMessage:
1955	      title: Validation message
1956	      description: Messages describing a validation error.
1957	      type: object
1958	      properties:
1959	        message:
1960	          title: Message
1961	          description: The validation message.
1962	          type: string
1963	          example: "[Path '/lastName'] Instance type (null) does not match any allowed primitive type (allowed: ['string'])"
1964	          readOnly: true
1965	      required:
1966	        - message
1967	      additionalProperties: true
1968	    Specialty:
1969	      title: Specialty
1970	      description: Fields of specialty of vets.
1971	      type: object
1972	      properties:
1973	        id:
1974	          title: ID
1975	          description: The ID of the specialty.
1976	          type: integer
1977	          format: int32
1978	          minimum: 0
1979	          example: 1
1980	          readOnly: true
1981	        name:
1982	          title: Name
1983	          description: The name of the specialty.
1984	          type: string
1985	          maxLength: 80
1986	          minLength: 1
1987	          example: radiology
1988	      required:
1989	        - id
1990	        - name
1991	    OwnerFields:
1992	      title: Owner fields
1993	      description: Editable fields of a pet owner.
1994	      type: object
1995	      properties:
1996	        firstName:
1997	          title: First name
1998	          description: The first name of the pet owner.
1999	          type: string
2000	          minLength: 1
2001	          maxLength: 30
2002	          pattern: "^[\\p{L}]+([ '-][\\p{L}]+){0,2}$"
2003	          example: George
2004	        lastName:
2005	          title: Last name
2006	          description: The last name of the pet owner.
2007	          type: string
2008	          minLength: 1
2009	          maxLength: 30
2010	          pattern: "^[\\p{L}]+([ '-][\\p{L}]+){0,2}\\.?$"
2011	          example: Franklin
2012	        title:
2013	          title: Title
2014	          description: >-
2015	            The optional honorific title of the pet owner (one of MR, MRS, MS,
2016	            DR). When present it is combined with the last name to form the
2017	            owner's 'salutation'.
2018	          type: string
2019	          example: DR
2020	        address:
2021	          title: Address
2022	          description: >-
2023	            The postal address of the pet owner. Accepted for backward
2024	            compatibility; when the structured 'addressLine1' is supplied it is
2025	            preferred. On read this carries the composed, normalized address (the
2026	            normalized 'addressLine1', with a single space and the normalized
2027	            'addressLine2' appended when an 'addressLine2' was supplied).
2028	          type: string
2029	          minLength: 1
2030	          maxLength: 255
2031	          example: '110 W. Liberty St.'
2032	        addressLine1:
2033	          title: Address line 1
2034	          description: >-
2035	            The first line of the pet owner's structured postal address. When
2036	            present (non-blank) it is preferred over the flat 'address'. On
2037	            create it is normalized (upper-cased, whitespace collapsed, common
2038	            street-type abbreviations expanded) and stored.
2039	          type: string
2040	          minLength: 1
2041	          maxLength: 255
2042	          example: '110 W. Liberty St.'
2043	        addressLine2:
2044	          title: Address line 2
2045	          description: >-
2046	            The optional second line of the pet owner's structured postal
2047	            address. When present it is normalized (upper-cased, whitespace
2048	            collapsed, common street-type abbreviations expanded) and appended
2049	            to the composed 'address' after a single space.
2050	          type: string
2051	          maxLength: 255
2052	          example: 'Apartment 4B'
2053	        city:
2054	          title: City
2055	          description: The city of the pet owner.
2056	          type: string
2057	          minLength: 1
2058	          maxLength: 80
2059	          example: Madison
2060	        telephone:
2061	          title: Telephone number
2062	          description: >-
2063	            The telephone number of the pet owner. On create the value is
2064	            normalized to E.164 form: a leading '+' and country code are kept,
2065	            otherwise country code '+61' is assumed and a single leading '0' is
2066	            dropped from the national digits; spaces, dashes and brackets are
2067	            stripped. The result must be a '+' followed by 8 to 15 digits.
2068	          type: string
2069	          minLength: 1
2070	          maxLength: 20
2071	          example: '+61412345678'
2072	        email:
2073	          title: Email address
2074	          description: >-
2075	            The optional email address of the pet owner. When present it must be
2076	            a syntactically valid address; the value is stored and returned
2077	            lower-cased.
2078	          type: string
2079	          format: email
2080	          minLength: 1
2081	          maxLength: 255
2082	          example: george.franklin@example.com
2083	        registrationDate:

2086	            The date the pet owner was registered, in ISO 'YYYY-MM-DD' format.
2087	            Optional on create; when omitted the server sets it to its current
2088	            date.
2089	          type: string
2090	          format: date
2091	          example: '2020-06-15'
2092	        birthDate:
2093	          title: Birth date
2094	          description: >-
2095	            The optional birth date of the pet owner, in ISO 'YYYY-MM-DD'
2096	            format. When present it is used to derive the owner's 'ageBand'
2097	            (computed as the owner's age on the registration date).
2098	          type: string
2099	          format: date
2100	          example: '1990-01-01'
2101	        postcode:
2102	          title: Postcode
2103	          description: >-
2104	            The optional 4-digit postcode of the pet owner. When present it must
2105	            be a 4-digit value that is valid for the owner's city per the fixed
2106	            city-to-region table (Sydney -> NSW 2000-2099, Melbourne -> VIC
2107	            3000-3099, Brisbane -> QLD 4000-4099). A city with no known region

2109	            given.

2116	            intentionally shares a household with an existing owner (same last

2118	            bypassed and the owner is created anyway.

2120	          writeOnly: true

2130	      allOf:

2135	              title: ID

2156	              example: 'DR Franklin'
2157	              readOnly: true
2158	            initials:
2159	              title: Initials
2160	              description: >-
2161	                The upper-cased first letters of the owner's first and last
2162	                names, dot-separated with a trailing dot.
2163	              type: string
2164	              example: 'G.F.'
2165	              readOnly: true
2166	            memberId:
2167	              title: Member id
2168	              description: >-
2169	                The owner's unified member id, formatted
2170	                '<REGION><FY><HASH8><CHK>' where REGION is the region code
2171	                derived from the owner's postcode, FY is the two-digit fiscal
2172	                year of the business-day-adjusted registration date (the fiscal
2173	                year starts on 1 July and is named by the calendar year in which
2174	                it ends), HASH8 is the first 8 upper-case hex characters of
2175	                SHA-256 over the normalized telephone concatenated with the last
2176	                name, and CHK is a single Luhn check digit computed over the
2177	                digits of '<REGION><FY><HASH8>'.
2178	              type: string

2180	              readOnly: true
2181	            fiscalYear:
2182	              title: Fiscal year
2183	              description: >-
2184	                The fiscal year of the owner's business-day-adjusted
2185	                registration date, formatted 'FY<YY>' where YY is the last two
2186	                digits of the fiscal year. The fiscal year starts on 1 July and
2187	                is named by the calendar year in which it ends, so a
2188	                registration date on or after 1 July belongs to the following
2189	                calendar year's fiscal year.

2194	              title: Household ID

2197	                household (same last name and address). It is assigned when an
2198	                owner is created with 'sharesHousehold' true and is identical for
2199	                every owner in that household.

2202	              readOnly: true
2203	            identityKey:

2209	                treated as duplicates only when their whole identity keys match.
2210	              type: string

2212	              readOnly: true
2213	            namesakeCount:
2214	              title: Namesake count

2216	                The number of owners that already existed, at the time this owner

2220	              format: int32
2221	              minimum: 0
2222	              example: 1
2223	              readOnly: true

2232	                fiscal year).

2234	              format: int32
2235	              minimum: 0
2236	              example: 3
2237	              readOnly: true
2238	            membershipLevel:
2239	              title: Membership level
2240	              description: >-

2245	              format: int32

components:
  schemas:
    ProblemDetail:
      title: Problem Detail
      description: The schema for all error responses.
      type: object
      properties:
        type:
          title: Type
          description: Full URL that originated the error response.
          type: string
          format: uri
          example: 'http://localhost:9966/petclinic/api/owner'
          readOnly: true
        title:
          title: Title
          description: The short error title.
          type: string
          example: NoResourceFoundException
          readOnly: true
        status:
          title: Status
          description: HTTP status code
          type: integer
          format: int32
          minimum: 400
          maximum: 600
          exclusiveMaximum: true
          example: 500
          readOnly: true
        detail:
          title: Detail
          description: The long error message.
          type: string
          example: 'No static resource api/owner.'
          readOnly: true
        timestamp:
          title: Timestamp
          description: The time the error occurred.
          type: string
          format: date-time
          example: '2024-11-23T13:59:21.3820407Z'
          readOnly: true
        schemaValidationErrors:
          title: Schema validation errors
          description: Validation errors against the OpenAPI schema.
          type: array
          items:
            $ref: '#/components/schemas/ValidationMessage'
      required:
        - type
        - title
        - status
        - detail
        - timestamp
        - schemaValidationErrors
    ValidationMessage:
      title: Validation message
      description: Messages describing a validation error.
      type: object
      properties:
        message:
          title: Message
          description: The validation message.
          type: string
          example: "[Path '/lastName'] Instance type (null) does not match any allowed primitive type (allowed: ['string'])"
          readOnly: true
      required:
        - message
      additionalProperties: true
    Specialty:
      title: Specialty
      description: Fields of specialty of vets.
      type: object
      properties:
        id:
          title: ID
          description: The ID of the specialty.
          type: integer
          format: int32
          minimum: 0
          example: 1
          readOnly: true
        name:
          title: Name
          description: The name of the specialty.
          type: string
          maxLength: 80
          minLength: 1
          example: radiology
      required:
        - id
        - name
    OwnerFields:
      title: Owner fields
      description: Editable fields of a pet owner.
      type: object
      properties:
        firstName:
          title: First name
          description: The first name of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 30
          pattern: "^[\\p{L}]+([ '-][\\p{L}]+){0,2}$"
          example: George
        lastName:
          title: Last name
          description: The last name of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 30
          pattern: "^[\\p{L}]+([ '-][\\p{L}]+){0,2}\\.?$"
          example: Franklin
        title:
          title: Title
          description: >-
            The optional honorific title of the pet owner (one of MR, MRS, MS,
            DR). When present it is combined with the last name to form the
            owner's 'salutation'.
          type: string
          example: DR
        address:
          title: Address
          description: >-
            The postal address of the pet owner. Accepted for backward
            compatibility; when the structured 'addressLine1' is supplied it is
            preferred. On read this carries the composed, normalized address (the
            normalized 'addressLine1', with a single space and the normalized
            'addressLine2' appended when an 'addressLine2' was supplied).
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 255
          example: '110 W. Liberty St.'
        addressLine1:
          title: Address line 1
          description: >-
            The first line of the pet owner's structured postal address. When
            present (non-blank) it is preferred over the flat 'address'. On
            create it is normalized (upper-cased, whitespace collapsed, common
            street-type abbreviations expanded) and stored.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 255
          example: '110 W. Liberty St.'
        addressLine2:
          title: Address line 2
          description: >-
            The optional second line of the pet owner's structured postal
            address. When present it is normalized (upper-cased, whitespace
            collapsed, common street-type abbreviations expanded) and appended
            to the composed 'address' after a single space.
          type: string
          maxLength: 255
          example: 'Apartment 4B'
        city:
          title: City
          description: The city of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 80
          example: Madison
        telephone:
          title: Telephone number
          description: >-
            The telephone number of the pet owner. On create the value is
            normalized to E.164 form: a leading '+' and country code are kept,
            otherwise country code '+61' is assumed and a single leading '0' is
            dropped from the national digits; spaces, dashes and brackets are
            stripped. The result must be a '+' followed by 8 to 15 digits.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 20
          example: '+61412345678'
        email:
          title: Email address
          description: >-
            The optional email address of the pet owner. When present it must be
            a syntactically valid address; the value is stored and returned
            lower-cased.
          type: string
          format: email
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 255
          example: george.franklin@example.com
        registrationDate:
          title: Registration date
          description: >-
            The date the pet owner was registered, in ISO 'YYYY-MM-DD' format.
            Optional on create; when omitted the server sets it to its current
            date.
          type: string
          format: date
          example: '2020-06-15'
        birthDate:
          title: Birth date
          description: >-
            The optional birth date of the pet owner, in ISO 'YYYY-MM-DD'
            format. When present it is used to derive the owner's 'ageBand'
            (computed as the owner's age on the registration date).
          type: string
          format: date
          example: '1990-01-01'
        postcode:
          title: Postcode
          description: >-
            The optional 4-digit postcode of the pet owner. When present it must
            be a 4-digit value that is valid for the owner's city per the fixed
            city-to-region table (Sydney -> NSW 2000-2099, Melbourne -> VIC
            3000-3099, Brisbane -> QLD 4000-4099). A city with no known region
            accepts any 4-digit postcode. The value is stored and returned as
            given.
          type: string
          example: '2000'
        sharesHousehold:
          title: Shares household
          description: >-
            Write-only flag set on create to acknowledge that this owner
            intentionally shares a household with an existing owner (same last
            name and address). When true, the duplicate-household check is
            bypassed and the owner is created anyway.
          type: boolean
          writeOnly: true
          example: true
      required:
        - firstName
        - lastName
        - city
        - telephone
    Owner:
      title: Owner
      description: A pet owner.
      allOf:
        - $ref: '#/components/schemas/OwnerFields'
        - type: object
          properties:
            id:
              title: ID
              description: The ID of the pet owner.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 1
              readOnly: true
            displayName:
              title: Display name
              description: >-
                The owner's name formatted as 'LastName, FirstName' from the
                stored first and last names.
              type: string
              example: 'Franklin, George'
              readOnly: true
            salutation:
              title: Salutation
              description: >-
                The owner's salutation, formatted '<title> <lastName>' when a
                title was supplied, otherwise just the last name.
              type: string
              example: 'DR Franklin'
              readOnly: true
            initials:
              title: Initials
              description: >-
                The upper-cased first letters of the owner's first and last
                names, dot-separated with a trailing dot.
              type: string
              example: 'G.F.'
              readOnly: true
            memberId:
              title: Member id
              description: >-
                The owner's unified member id, formatted
                '<REGION><FY><HASH8><CHK>' where REGION is the region code
                derived from the owner's postcode, FY is the two-digit fiscal
                year of the business-day-adjusted registration date (the fiscal
                year starts on 1 July and is named by the calendar year in which
                it ends), HASH8 is the first 8 upper-case hex characters of
                SHA-256 over the normalized telephone concatenated with the last
                name, and CHK is a single Luhn check digit computed over the
                digits of '<REGION><FY><HASH8>'.
              type: string
              example: 'NSW263F2A1B9C7'
              readOnly: true
            fiscalYear:
              title: Fiscal year
              description: >-
                The fiscal year of the owner's business-day-adjusted
                registration date, formatted 'FY<YY>' where YY is the last two
                digits of the fiscal year. The fiscal year starts on 1 July and
                is named by the calendar year in which it ends, so a
                registration date on or after 1 July belongs to the following
                calendar year's fiscal year.
              type: string
              example: 'FY26'
              readOnly: true
            householdId:
              title: Household ID
              description: >-
                A stable shared identifier for owners that belong to the same
                household (same last name and address). It is assigned when an
                owner is created with 'sharesHousehold' true and is identical for
                every owner in that household.
              type: string
              example: 'HH-3F2A1B9C4D5E'
              readOnly: true
            identityKey:
              title: Identity key
              description: >-
                The owner's derived duplicate-detection key, formatted
                '<normalizedTelephone>|<email>|<householdId>' where the email and
                household id segments are empty when absent. Two owners are
                treated as duplicates only when their whole identity keys match.
              type: string
              example: '+61412345678||HH-3F2A1B9C4D5E'
              readOnly: true
            namesakeCount:
              title: Namesake count
              description: >-
                The number of owners that already existed, at the time this owner
                was created, sharing the same first and last name (compared
                case-insensitively). Excludes the owner itself.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 1
              readOnly: true
            membershipPoints:
              title: Membership points
              description: >-
                The owner's membership points, starting at 0. Gains 2 when an
                email is present, 1 when the owner has no namesakes
                (namesakeCount is 0), 2 for a household of 3 or more, and 3 when
                the owner's tenure spans at least one elapsed fiscal year (the
                registration date's fiscal year is earlier than the current
                fiscal year).
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 3
              readOnly: true
            membershipLevel:
              title: Membership level
              description: >-
                The owner's membership level, a number from 1 to 4 derived from
                the owner's membership points: 1 for 0-1 points, 2 for 2-3, 3
                for 4-5, and 4 for 6 or more.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 1
              maximum: 4
              example: 2
              readOnly: true
            ownerSegment:
              title: Owner segment
              description: >-
                The owner's segment, formatted '<TIER>_<AREA>'. TIER is
                'PREMIUM' when the owner's membershipLevel is 3 or more,
                otherwise 'STANDARD'. AREA is 'METRO' when the owner's locality
                is a known region (NSW, VIC or QLD), otherwise 'REGIONAL'.
              type: string
              enum:
                - PREMIUM_METRO
                - PREMIUM_REGIONAL
                - STANDARD_METRO
                - STANDARD_REGIONAL
              example: 'STANDARD_METRO'
              readOnly: true
            bulkSignupWarning:
              title: Bulk signup warning
              description: >-
                Whether the owner was created on a day that had already reached
                the bulk-signup threshold: true when more than 80 owners had
                already been created for the owner's registration date at the
                time this owner was created, otherwise false.
              type: boolean
              example: false
              readOnly: true
            capacityWarning:
              title: Capacity warning
              description: >-
                Whether the owner's city is approaching its capacity limit: true
                when the city already held between 40 and 49 owners
                (inclusive) at the time this owner was created, otherwise false.
                The hard limit of 50 owners per city still rejects the create.
              type: boolean
              example: false
              readOnly: true
            locality:
              title: Locality
              description: >-
                The owner's locality, the REGION segment of the owner's member
                id (the leading region code of '<REGION><FY><HASH8><CHK>').
                'UNKNOWN' when no region could be resolved.
              type: string
              example: 'NSW'
              readOnly: true
            timezone:
              title: Timezone
              description: >-
                The owner's IANA timezone name, derived from the owner's
                locality/region via the fixed region-to-timezone table:
                NSW->Australia/Sydney, VIC->Australia/Melbourne,
                QLD->Australia/Brisbane. Absent when no region could be
                resolved.
              type: string
              example: 'Australia/Sydney'
              readOnly: true
            contactPreference:
              title: Contact preference
              description: >-
                The owner's preferred contact channel, derived on read: 'EMAIL'
                when an email address is present, otherwise 'PHONE'.
              type: string
              example: 'EMAIL'
              readOnly: true
            telephoneDisplay:
              title: Telephone display
              description: >-
                The owner's stored E.164 telephone formatted for humans: the
                country code, a space, then the national digits grouped in
                threes (e.g. '+61 412 345 678'). The raw 'telephone' field stays
                in E.164 form.
              type: string
              example: '+61 412 345 678'
              readOnly: true
            ageBand:
              title: Age band
              description: >-
                The owner's age band, derived from the birth date when present:
                'MINOR' when under 18, 'ADULT' from 18 to 64, and 'SENIOR' at 65
                or older, computed as the owner's age on the registration date.
                Absent when no birth date was supplied.
              type: string
              enum:
                - MINOR
                - ADULT
                - SENIOR
              example: 'ADULT'
              readOnly: true
            possibleDuplicate:
              title: Possible duplicate
              description: >-
                Whether this owner, at the time it was created, was a soft
                (non-hard) duplicate of an existing owner: true when it shared an
                existing owner's last name and postcode but had a different
                telephone, otherwise false.
              type: boolean
              example: false
              readOnly: true
            possibleDuplicateOf:
              title: Possible duplicate of
              description: >-
                The id of the existing owner this owner was found to softly
                duplicate (same last name and postcode, different telephone) at
                the time it was created. Absent when 'possibleDuplicate' is
                false.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 1
              readOnly: true
            riskFlag:
              title: Risk flag
              description: >-
                Whether the owner is flagged for review. True when any of the
                following hold: the owner is a possible duplicate
                ('possibleDuplicate' is true), the email domain is
                disposable-adjacent (its second-level label matches a known
                disposable email provider - mailinator, tempmail or guerrillamail
                - such as a different top-level domain or a subdomain of one),
                or the owner's city is over its soft capacity ('capacityWarning'
                is true). Otherwise false.
              type: boolean
              example: false
              readOnly: true
            selfLink:
              title: Self link
              description: >-
                A link to this owner's own resource, formatted '/api/owners/<id>'
                where id is the owner's id.
              type: string
              example: '/api/owners/1'
              readOnly: true
            deleted:
              title: Deleted
              description: >-
                Whether the owner has been soft-deleted. A newly created owner is
                false; DELETE /api/owners/{id} marks the owner deleted (true)
                while retaining the record.
              type: boolean
              example: false
              readOnly: true
            pets:
              title: Pets
              description: The pets owned by this individual including any booked vet visits.
              type: array
              items:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/Pet'
              readOnly: true
          required:
            - pets
    OwnerPage:
      title: Owner page
      description: A page of pet owners.
      type: object
      properties:
        content:
          title: Content
          description: Pet owners in the requested page.
          type: array
          items:
            $ref: '#/components/schemas/Owner'
        page:
          title: Page
          description: Zero-based page index.
          type: integer
          format: int32
          minimum: 0
          example: 0
        size:
          title: Size
          description: Requested page size.
          type: integer
          format: int32
          minimum: 1
          example: 5
        totalElements:
          title: Total elements
          description: Total number of owners matching the request.
          type: integer
          format: int64
          minimum: 0
          example: 10
        totalPages:
          title: Total pages
          description: Total number of pages matching the request.
          type: integer
          format: int32
          minimum: 0
          example: 2
      required:
        - content
        - page
        - size
        - totalElements
        - totalPages
    PetPage:
      title: Pet page
      description: A page of pets.
      type: object
      properties:
        content:
          title: Content
          description: Pets in the requested page.
          type: array
          items:
            $ref: '#/components/schemas/Pet'
        page:
          title: Page
          description: Zero-based page index.
          type: integer
          format: int32
          minimum: 0
          example: 0
        size:
          title: Size
          description: Requested page size.
          type: integer
          format: int32
          minimum: 1
          example: 5
        totalElements:
          title: Total elements
          description: Total number of pets matching the request.
          type: integer
          format: int64
          minimum: 0
          example: 10
        totalPages:
          title: Total pages
          description: Total number of pages matching the request.
          type: integer
          format: int32
          minimum: 0
          example: 2
      required:
        - content
        - page
        - size
        - totalElements
        - totalPages
    PetFields:
      title: Pet fields
      description: Editable fields of a pet.
      type: object
      properties:
        name:
          title: Name
          description: The name of the pet.
          type: string
          maxLength: 30
          example: Leo
        birthDate:
          title: Birth date
          description: The date of birth of the pet.
          type: string
          format: date
          example: '2010-09-07'
          x-field-extra-annotation: "@org.springframework.samples.petclinic.rest.validation.PetAgeValidation"
        type:
          $ref: '#/components/schemas/PetType'
      required:
        - name
        - birthDate
        - type
    Pet:
      title: Pet
      description: A pet.
      allOf:
        - $ref: '#/components/schemas/PetFields'
        - type: object
          properties:
            id:
              title: ID
              description: The ID of the pet.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 1
              readOnly: true
            ownerId:
              title: Owner ID
              description: The ID of the pet's owner.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 1
              readOnly: true
            visits:
              title: Visits
              description: Vet visit bookings for this pet.
              type: array
              items:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/Visit'
              readOnly: true
          required:
            - id
            - type
            - visits
    VetFields:
      title: VetFields
      description: Editable fields of a veterinarian.
      type: object
      properties:
        firstName:
          title: First name
          description: The first name of the vet.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 30
          pattern: "^[\\p{L}]+([ '-][\\p{L}]+){0,2}$"
          example: 'James'
        lastName:
          title: Last name
          description: The last name of the vet.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 30
          pattern: "^[\\p{L}]+([ '-][\\p{L}]+){0,2}\\.?$"
          example: 'Carter'
        specialties:
          title: Specialties
          description: The specialties of the vet.
          type: array
          items:
            $ref: '#/components/schemas/Specialty'
      required:
        - firstName
        - lastName
        - specialties
    Vet:
      title: Vet
      description: A veterinarian.
      allOf:
        - $ref: '#/components/schemas/VetFields'
        - type: object
          properties:
            id:
              title: ID
              description: The ID of the vet.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 1
              readOnly: true
      required:
        - id
        - firstName
        - lastName
        - specialties
    VisitFields:
      title: Visit fields
      description: Editable fields of a vet visit.
      type: object
      properties:
        date:
          title: Date
          description: The date of the visit.
          type: string
          format: date
          example: '2013-01-01'
        description:
          title: Description
          description: The description for the visit.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 255
          example: 'rabies shot'
      required:
        - description
    Visit:
      title: Visit
      description: A booking for a vet visit.
      allOf:
        - $ref: '#/components/schemas/VisitFields'
        - type: object
          properties:
            id:
              title: ID
              description: The ID of the visit.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 1
              readOnly: true
            petId:
              title: Pet ID
              description: The ID of the pet.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 1
          required:
            - id
            - petId
    PetTypeFields:
      title: PetType fields
      description: Editable fields of a pet type.
      type: object
      properties:
        name:
          title: Name
          description: The name of the pet type.
          type: string
          maxLength: 80
          minLength: 1
          example: cat
      required:
        - name
    PetType:
      title: Pet type
      description: A pet type.
      allOf:
        - $ref: '#/components/schemas/PetTypeFields'
        - type: object
          properties:
            id:
              title: ID
              description: The ID of the pet type.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 1
          required:
            - id
    User:
      title: User
      description: An user.
      type: object
      properties:
        username:
          title: username
          description: The username
          type: string
          maxLength: 80
          minLength: 1
          example: john.doe
        password:
          title: Password
          description: The password
          type: string
          maxLength: 80
          minLength: 1
          example: 1234abc
        enabled:
          title: enabled
          description: Indicates if the user is enabled
          type: boolean
          example: true
        roles:
          title: Roles
          description: The roles of an user
          type: array
          items:
            $ref: '#/components/schemas/Role'
      required:
        - username
    Role:
      title: Role
      description: A role.
      type: object
      properties:
        name:
          title: name
          description: The role's name
          type: string
          maxLength: 80
          minLength: 1
          example: admin
      required:
        - name

<groupId>org.openapitools</groupId>
                <artifactId>openapi-generator-maven-plugin</artifactId>
                <!-- RELEASE_VERSION -->
                <version>${maven.openapi-generator-plugin.version}</version>
                <!-- /RELEASE_VERSION -->
                <executions>
                    <execution>
                        <goals>
                            <goal>generate</goal>
                        </goals>
                        <configuration>
                            <inputSpec>${project.basedir}/src/main/resources/openapi.yml</inputSpec>
                            <generatorName>spring</generatorName>
                            <library>spring-boot</library>

                            <!-- Only enabling model andopenapi-generator-maven-plugin API generation -->
                            <modelNameSuffix>Dto</modelNameSuffix>
                            <apiPackage>org.springframework.samples.petclinic.rest.api</apiPackage>
                            <generateModels>true</generateModels>
                            <modelPackage>org.springframework.samples.petclinic.rest.dto</modelPackage>
                            <generateApis>true</generateApis>
                            <importMappings>
                                <importMapping>Nullable=org.jspecify.annotations.Nullable</importMapping>
                            </importMappings>
                            <configOptions>
                                <!-- RestController implementation is provided by Petclinic developers -->
                                <interfaceOnly>true</interfaceOnly>
                                <!-- Generate API interfaces from OpenAPI tags -->
                                <useTags>true</useTags>
                                <!-- Activating Java 8 features -->
                                <performBeanValidation>true</performBeanValidation>
                                <useSpringBoot3>true</useSpringBoot3>
                                <useJakartaEe>true</useJakartaEe>
                                <openApiNullable>false</openApiNullable>
                                <!-- override the default library to jersey2 -->
                                <serializationLibrary>jackson</serializationLibrary>
                                <!-- switch documentation provider to springdoc -->
                                <documentationProvider>springdoc</documentationProvider>
                            </configOptions>
                        </configuration>
                    </execution>
                </executions>
            </plugin>
            <plugin>
                <groupId>org.codehaus.mojo</groupId>
                <artifactId>build-helper-maven-plugin</artifactId>
                <executions>
                    <execution>
                        <id>add-source</id>
                        <phase>generate-sources</phase>
                        <goals>
                            <goal>add-source</goal>
                        </goals>
                        <configuration>
                            <sources>
                                <source>target/generated-sources/openapi/src/main/java</source>
                            </sources>
                        </configuration>
                    </execution>
                </executions>
            </plugin>
            <plugin>
                <groupId>org.apache.maven.plugins</groupId>
                <artifactId>maven-compiler-plugin</artifactId>
                <executions>
                    <execution>
                        <id>default-compile</id>
                        <configuration>
                            <annotationProcessorPaths>
                                <path>
                                    <groupId>org.mapstruct</groupId>
                                    <artifactId>mapstruct-processor</artifactId>
                                    <version>${mapstruct.version}</version>
                                </path>

components:
  schemas:
    ProblemDetail:
      title: Problem Detail
      description: The schema for all error responses.
      type: object
      properties:
        type:
          title: Type
          description: Full URL that originated the error response.
          type: string
          format: uri
          example: 'http://localhost:9966/petclinic/api/owner'
          readOnly: true
        title:
          title: Title
          description: The short error title.
          type: string
          example: NoResourceFoundException
          readOnly: true
        status:
          title: Status
          description: HTTP status code
          type: integer
          format: int32
          minimum: 400
          maximum: 600
          exclusiveMaximum: true
          example: 500
          readOnly: true
        detail:
          title: Detail
          description: The long error message.
          type: string
          example: 'No static resource api/owner.'
          readOnly: true
        timestamp:
          title: Timestamp
          description: The time the error occurred.
          type: string
          format: date-time
          example: '2024-11-23T13:59:21.3820407Z'
          readOnly: true
        schemaValidationErrors:
          title: Schema validation errors
          description: Validation errors against the OpenAPI schema.
          type: array
          items:
            $ref: '#/components/schemas/ValidationMessage'
      required:
        - type
        - title
        - status
        - detail
        - timestamp
        - schemaValidationErrors
    ValidationMessage:
      title: Validation message
      description: Messages describing a validation error.
      type: object
      properties:
        message:
          title: Message
          description: The validation message.
          type: string
          example: "[Path '/lastName'] Instance type (null) does not match any allowed primitive type (allowed: ['string'])"
          readOnly: true
      required:
        - message
      additionalProperties: true
    Specialty:
      title: Specialty
      description: Fields of specialty of vets.
      type: object
      properties:
        id:
          title: ID
          description: The ID of the specialty.
          type: integer
          format: int32
          minimum: 0
          example: 1
          readOnly: true
        name:
          title: Name
          description: The name of the specialty.
          type: string
          maxLength: 80
          minLength: 1
          example: radiology
      required:
        - id
        - name
    OwnerFields:
      title: Owner fields
      description: Editable fields of a pet owner.
      type: object
      properties:
        firstName:
          title: First name
          description: The first name of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 30
          pattern: "^[\\p{L}]+([ '-][\\p{L}]+){0,2}$"
          example: George
        lastName:
          title: Last name
          description: The last name of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 30
          pattern: "^[\\p{L}]+([ '-][\\p{L}]+){0,2}\\.?$"
          example: Franklin
        title:
          title: Title
          description: >-
            The optional honorific title of the pet owner (one of MR, MRS, MS,
            DR). When present it is combined with the last name to form the
            owner's 'salutation'.
          type: string
          example: DR
        address:
          title: Address
          description: >-
            The postal address of the pet owner. Accepted for backward
            compatibility; when the structured 'addressLine1' is supplied it is
            preferred. On read this carries the composed, normalized address (the
            normalized 'addressLine1', with a single space and the normalized
            'addressLine2' appended when an 'addressLine2' was supplied).
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 255
          example: '110 W. Liberty St.'
        addressLine1:
          title: Address line 1
          description: >-
            The first line of the pet owner's structured postal address. When
            present (non-blank) it is preferred over the flat 'address'. On
            create it is normalized (upper-cased, whitespace collapsed, common
            street-type abbreviations expanded) and stored.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 255
          example: '110 W. Liberty St.'
        addressLine2:
          title: Address line 2
          description: >-
            The optional second line of the pet owner's structured postal
            address. When present it is normalized (upper-cased, whitespace
            collapsed, common street-type abbreviations expanded) and appended
            to the composed 'address' after a single space.
          type: string
          maxLength: 255
          example: 'Apartment 4B'
        city:
          title: City
          description: The city of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 80
          example: Madison
        telephone:
          title: Telephone number
          description: >-
            The telephone number of the pet owner. On create the value is
            normalized to E.164 form: a leading '+' and country code are kept,
            otherwise country code '+61' is assumed and a single leading '0' is
            dropped from the national digits; spaces, dashes and brackets are
            stripped. The result must be a '+' followed by 8 to 15 digits.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 20
          example: '+61412345678'
        email:
          title: Email address
          description: >-
            The optional email address of the pet owner. When present it must be
            a syntactically valid address; the value is stored and returned
            lower-cased.
          type: string
          format: email
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 255
          example: george.franklin@example.com
        registrationDate:
          title: Registration date
          description: >-
            The date the pet owner was registered, in ISO 'YYYY-MM-DD' format.
            Optional on create; when omitted the server sets it to its current
            date.
          type: string
          format: date
          example: '2020-06-15'
        birthDate:
          title: Birth date
          description: >-
            The optional birth date of the pet owner, in ISO 'YYYY-MM-DD'
            format. When present it is used to derive the owner's 'ageBand'
            (computed as the owner's age on the registration date).
          type: string
          format: date
          example: '1990-01-01'
        postcode:
          title: Postcode
          description: >-
            The optional 4-digit postcode of the pet owner. When present it must
            be a 4-digit value that is valid for the owner's city per the fixed
            city-to-region table (Sydney -> NSW 2000-2099, Melbourne -> VIC
            3000-3099, Brisbane -> QLD 4000-4099). A city with no known region
            accepts any 4-digit postcode. The value is stored and returned as
            given.
          type: string
          example: '2000'
        sharesHousehold:
          title: Shares household
          description: >-
            Write-only flag set on create to acknowledge that this owner
            intentionally shares a household with an existing owner (same last
            name and address). When true, the duplicate-household check is
            bypassed and the owner is created anyway.
          type: boolean
          writeOnly: true
          example: true
      required:
        - firstName
        - lastName
        - city
        - telephone
    Owner:
      title: Owner
      description: A pet owner.
      allOf:
        - $ref: '#/components/schemas/OwnerFields'
        - type: object
          properties:
            id:
              title: ID
              description: The ID of the pet owner.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 1
              readOnly: true
            displayName:
              title: Display name
              description: >-
                The owner's name formatted as 'LastName, FirstName' from the
                stored first and last names.
              type: string
              example: 'Franklin, George'
              readOnly: true
            salutation:
              title: Salutation
              description: >-
                The owner's salutation, formatted '<title> <lastName>' when a
                title was supplied, otherwise just the last name.
              type: string
              example: 'DR Franklin'
              readOnly: true
            initials:
              title: Initials
              description: >-
                The upper-cased first letters of the owner's first and last
                names, dot-separated with a trailing dot.
              type: string
              example: 'G.F.'
              readOnly: true
            memberId:
              title: Member id
              description: >-
                The owner's unified member id, formatted
                '<REGION><FY><HASH8><CHK>' where REGION is the region code
                derived from the owner's postcode, FY is the two-digit fiscal
                year of the business-day-adjusted registration date (the fiscal
                year starts on 1 July and is named by the calendar year in which
                it ends), HASH8 is the first 8 upper-case hex characters of
                SHA-256 over the normalized telephone concatenated with the last
                name, and CHK is a single Luhn check digit computed over the
                digits of '<REGION><FY><HASH8>'.
              type: string
              example: 'NSW263F2A1B9C7'
              readOnly: true
            fiscalYear:
              title: Fiscal year
              description: >-
                The fiscal year of the owner's business-day-adjusted
                registration date, formatted 'FY<YY>' where YY is the last two
                digits of the fiscal year. The fiscal year starts on 1 July and
                is named by the calendar year in which it ends, so a
                registration date on or after 1 July belongs to the following
                calendar year's fiscal year.
              type: string
              example: 'FY26'
              readOnly: true
            householdId:
              title: Household ID
              description: >-
                A stable shared identifier for owners that belong to the same
                household (same last name and address). It is assigned when an
                owner is created with 'sharesHousehold' true and is identical for
                every owner in that household.
              type: string
              example: 'HH-3F2A1B9C4D5E'
              readOnly: true
            identityKey:
              title: Identity key
              description: >-
                The owner's derived duplicate-detection key, formatted
                '<normalizedTelephone>|<email>|<householdId>' where the email and
                household id segments are empty when absent. Two owners are
                treated as duplicates only when their whole identity keys match.
              type: string
              example: '+61412345678||HH-3F2A1B9C4D5E'
              readOnly: true
            namesakeCount:
              title: Namesake count
              description: >-
                The number of owners that already existed, at the time this owner
                was created, sharing the same first and last name (compared
                case-insensitively). Excludes the owner itself.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 1
              readOnly: true
            membershipPoints:
              title: Membership points
              description: >-
                The owner's membership points, starting at 0. Gains 2 when an
                email is present, 1 when the owner has no namesakes
                (namesakeCount is 0), 2 for a household of 3 or more, and 3 when
                the owner's tenure spans at least one elapsed fiscal year (the
                registration date's fiscal year is earlier than the current
                fiscal year).
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 3
              readOnly: true
            membershipLevel:
              title: Membership level
              description: >-
                The owner's membership level, a number from 1 to 4 derived from
                the owner's membership points: 1 for 0-1 points, 2 for 2-3, 3
                for 4-5, and 4 for 6 or more.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 1
              maximum: 4
              example: 2
              readOnly: true
            ownerSegment:
              title: Owner segment
              description: >-
                The owner's segment, formatted '<TIER>_<AREA>'. TIER is
                'PREMIUM' when the owner's membershipLevel is 3 or more,
                otherwise 'STANDARD'. AREA is 'METRO' when the owner's locality
                is a known region (NSW, VIC or QLD), otherwise 'REGIONAL'.
              type: string
              enum:
                - PREMIUM_METRO
                - PREMIUM_REGIONAL
                - STANDARD_METRO
                - STANDARD_REGIONAL
              example: 'STANDARD_METRO'
              readOnly: true
            bulkSignupWarning:
              title: Bulk signup warning
              description: >-
                Whether the owner was created on a day that had already reached
                the bulk-signup threshold: true when more than 80 owners had
                already been created for the owner's registration date at the
                time this owner was created, otherwise false.
              type: boolean
              example: false
              readOnly: true
            capacityWarning:
              title: Capacity warning
              description: >-
                Whether the owner's city is approaching its capacity limit: true
                when the city already held between 40 and 49 owners
                (inclusive) at the time this owner was created, otherwise false.
                The hard limit of 50 owners per city still rejects the create.
              type: boolean
              example: false
              readOnly: true
            locality:
              title: Locality
              description: >-
                The owner's locality, the REGION segment of the owner's member
                id (the leading region code of '<REGION><FY><HASH8><CHK>').
                'UNKNOWN' when no region could be resolved.
              type: string
              example: 'NSW'
              readOnly: true
            timezone:
              title: Timezone
              description: >-
                The owner's IANA timezone name, derived from the owner's
                locality/region via the fixed region-to-timezone table:
                NSW->Australia/Sydney, VIC->Australia/Melbourne,
                QLD->Australia/Brisbane. Absent when no region could be
                resolved.
              type: string
              example: 'Australia/Sydney'
              readOnly: true
            contactPreference:
              title: Contact preference
              description: >-
                The owner's preferred contact channel, derived on read: 'EMAIL'
                when an email address is present, otherwise 'PHONE'.
              type: string
              example: 'EMAIL'
              readOnly: true
            telephoneDisplay:
              title: Telephone display
              description: >-
                The owner's stored E.164 telephone formatted for humans: the
                country code, a space, then the national digits grouped in
                threes (e.g. '+61 412 345 678'). The raw 'telephone' field stays
                in E.164 form.
              type: string
              example: '+61 412 345 678'
              readOnly: true
            ageBand:
              title: Age band
              description: >-
                The owner's age band, derived from the birth date when present:
                'MINOR' when under 18, 'ADULT' from 18 to 64, and 'SENIOR' at 65
                or older, computed as the owner's age on the registration date.
                Absent when no birth date was supplied.
              type: string
              enum:
                - MINOR
                - ADULT
                - SENIOR
              example: 'ADULT'
              readOnly: true
            possibleDuplicate:
              title: Possible duplicate
              description: >-
                Whether this owner, at the time it was created, was a soft
                (non-hard) duplicate of an existing owner: true when it shared an
                existing owner's last name and postcode but had a different
                telephone, otherwise false.
              type: boolean
              example: false
              readOnly: true
            possibleDuplicateOf:
              title: Possible duplicate of
              description: >-
                The id of the existing owner this owner was found to softly
                duplicate (same last name and postcode, different telephone) at
                the time it was created. Absent when 'possibleDuplicate' is
                false.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 1
              readOnly: true
            riskFlag:
              title: Risk flag
              description: >-
                Whether the owner is flagged for review. True when any of the
                following hold: the owner is a possible duplicate
                ('possibleDuplicate' is true), the email domain is
                disposable-adjacent (its second-level label matches a known
                disposable email provider - mailinator, tempmail or guerrillamail
                - such as a different top-level domain or a subdomain of one),
                or the owner's city is over its soft capacity ('capacityWarning'
                is true). Otherwise false.
              type: boolean
              example: false
              readOnly: true
            selfLink:
              title: Self link
              description: >-
                A link to this owner's own resource, formatted '/api/owners/<id>'
                where id is the owner's id.
              type: string
              example: '/api/owners/1'
              readOnly: true
            deleted:
              title: Deleted
              description: >-
                Whether the owner has been soft-deleted. A newly created owner is
                false; DELETE /api/owners/{id} marks the owner deleted (true)
                while retaining the record.
              type: boolean
              example: false
              readOnly: true
            pets:
              title: Pets
              description: The pets owned by this individual including any booked vet visits.
              type: array
              items:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/Pet'
              readOnly: true
          required:
            - pets
